description: Offline request template for a built-in Teams website tab pointing at the configured improvement SharePoint list.
preconditions: Exact target team and channel IDs are supplied by the authorized deployment owner.
The built-in website tab app is available to the target team.
The SharePoint URL is HTTPS and its host matches one of the allowed SharePoint Online suffixes.
Graph tab-create permission and user scope are qualified separately before a native request.
